topics.name: Machine learning for vaccine epitope selection
topics.summary: Quantum feature models and active-learning strategies target pathogen epitope-receptor binding when labeled docking data are limited. Experiments compare data acquisition, model capacity, and generalization for PRRS vaccine candidates.

topics.name: Spatial computational pathology
topics.summary: Tissue architecture, spatial distances among tumor and immune phenotypes, and language-mediated embeddings are used to predict metastatic risk while reducing institution-specific batch effects. Histopathology experiments show that explicit context and robust representations improve transfer.

topics.name: Medical image synthesis and representation learning
topics.summary: Electrical impedance reconstruction, text-conditioned CT synthesis, and metadata-guided cardiac MRI pretraining use anatomical or acquisition context as supervision. Across stroke, ovarian cancer, and cardiac imaging, the recurring goal is faithful structure with limited labels.

topics.name: Cross-domain medical image segmentation and classification
topics.summary: Few-shot segmentation, uncertainty-gated multitask features, and multiscale MRI classifiers are tested across clinical cohorts, including external diabetic-foot-ulcer sets. Results emphasize architecture choice and cross-dataset validation because in-domain scores overstate deployment reliability.

topics.name: Clinical language models for diagnosis and evidence
topics.summary: Treatment agents, ICD coding probes, simulated doctor episodes, and point-of-care evaluations assess language models with biomedical tools, longitudinal cases, and clinician judgments. Iterative evidence gathering and internal evidence signals matter more than unsupported confidence or isolated answer accuracy.

topics.name: Dynamic Gaussian scene reconstruction
topics.summary: Object-centric, human-object, reflective-facade, and language-embedded Gaussian representations update geometry and semantics over time. Monocular video and UAV imagery are used to improve free-view rendering, interaction, and open-vocabulary scene maintenance.

topics.name: Diffusion methods for image and video restoration
topics.summary: Few-step denoising, frequency-specialized experts, optimal-control sampling, and geometry-aware conditioning address super-resolution, inverse problems, defogging, relighting, and sparse-view recovery. Evaluations trade reconstruction detail, temporal consistency, and compute cost against varied real-world degradation.

topics.name: Multimodal visual composition and virtual try-on
topics.summary: Composition-aware multimodal models learn layout intent for controlled image generation, while a mobile fitting pipeline uses hand landmarks, object detection, and geometric resizing for jewelry overlays. Both connect semantic understanding with visually constrained synthesis.

topics.name: Vision-language adaptation and grounding
topics.summary: Memory-based test-time adaptation, frozen-detector query-region alignment, exemplar calibration, and vision-language scaling improve localization under distribution shift. Benchmarks stress cross-dataset robustness, semantic faithfulness, and selective confidence rather than raw matching alone.

topics.name: Visual anomaly and change understanding
topics.summary: Component-level reconstruction, change-aware captioning and segmentation, and spectrum-disentangled detectors target logical inconsistencies, image changes, and tiny objects. Multi-benchmark tests show gains when semantic relations and frequency cues complement conventional local features.

topics.name: Video motion representation and compression
topics.summary: Optical-flow-aware encoding, self-supervised domain generalization, and efficient temporal grounding reduce storage or compute while preserving motion cues. Surveillance and multimodal video tests emphasize stale pixels, cross-domain variation, and fast localization.

topics.name: OCR and computational document recovery
topics.summary: Segmentation for stone inscriptions and number plates is combined with learned localization, while tomographic unrolling recovers text from sealed historical scrolls. The applications share a need for precise structure recovery under unusual surfaces, layouts, or imaging conditions.

topics.name: Adaptive inference for language models
topics.summary: Sampling ceilings, compressed attention memory, masked diffusion decoding, service scheduling, and event-triggered invocation address the cost and timing of language-model inference. The studies use selective computation and budget-aware controls to preserve quality under long contexts or streaming workloads.

topics.name: Neural sharpness and generalization
topics.summary: Closed-form Hessian-based updates and joint sharpness-complexity analyses examine why flatter solutions can generalize better. The work links spectral structure, optimization geometry, and empirical performance across neural-network settings.

topics.name: Stochastic optimization dynamics
topics.summary: Non-reversible Langevin analysis and dependent-data results for Adam characterize variance, tracking, and prediction behavior beyond stationary iid assumptions. The theoretical treatments seek sharper guarantees for noisy optimization in changing environments.

topics.name: Continual and parameter-efficient model adaptation
topics.summary: Federated expert routing, self-training knowledge updates, latent residual pretraining, and orthogonal low-rank adapters improve retention or specialization under limited compute. Experiments cover class-incremental learning, post-cutoff facts, and language-model reasoning benchmarks.

topics.name: Domain and language adaptation for AI assistants
topics.summary: Banking voice agents, Marathi translation, agricultural and transportation assistants, Portuguese encoders, and Indic translation systems rely on curated domain data and continued adaptation. Evaluations emphasize specialized usefulness, multilingual coverage, safety, and handoff to people or tools.

topics.name: Sign-language modeling and evaluation
topics.summary: Recognition and production systems are assessed with phonological structure, motion and grammatical quality, and linguistically motivated human-aligned metrics. The results show why aggregate recognition scores alone miss important signing distinctions.

topics.name: Entropy-regularized stochastic differential games
topics.summary: Entropy-controlled reinforcement learning and dynamic-programming formulations study zero-sum and Stackelberg games under regime-switching diffusion dynamics. Analytical solutions and learned policies clarify how exploration temperature affects equilibrium behavior.

topics.name: Macroeconomic and climate-sensitive forecasting
topics.summary: Vintage-aware time-series pretraining and decomposition, lag analysis, interrupted-series models, and SARIMAX forecasting connect changing observations with economic or fisheries outcomes. The evaluations stress leakage control, disruption effects, and practical decision support.

topics.name: Constrained and likelihood-aware generative simulation
topics.summary: Sampling-time feasibility operators and low-variance likelihood distillation make generative simulators more trustworthy and efficient. Financial tables and molecular Boltzmann generation show the shared emphasis on hard constraints, scalable sampling, and usable densities.

topics.name: Financial risk and market modeling
topics.summary: Graph-temporal causal models and liquidity-based audits analyze investment decisions and trading strategies under changing market conditions. Both use interpretable signals and stress tests to expose risk that headline returns can conceal.

topics.name: Strategic games and auction mechanisms
topics.summary: Continuum coalition dynamics, repeated-auction learning, and affine-mechanism equilibria study strategic behavior when incentives, switching, and exaggeration interact. The analyses combine equilibrium structure with adaptive or potential-game perspectives.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and sequential decision theory
topics.summary: Uncertainty-weighted baselines, reward-hacking safeguards, and geometric regret analysis address unstable or changing sequential control problems. The papers focus on verifiable rewards, modification-aware value learning, and the cost of policy changes under nonstationarity.

topics.name: Human-AI reliance and work design
topics.summary: Studies of virtual embodiment, writing assistance, medication automation, role-play companions, and worker fallback examine how AI changes trust, responsibility, skill investment, and dependence. Mixed-methods and economic models favor visible boundaries, correction paths, and preserved human capability.

topics.name: AI-supported education and learner modeling
topics.summary: Telemetry-based performance prediction, variance decomposition, diverse programming explanations, and hierarchical knowledge tracing connect learner state estimation with instructional support. Evaluations consider calibration, conceptual coverage, cognitive burden, and collaborative workflow quality.

topics.name: LLM personality and affective behavior
topics.summary: Ethical dilemmas, latent feature interventions, emotional motion, psychological emotion embeddings, and faith-oriented companion scenarios probe how model behavior changes with framing and pressure. Structured rubrics and targeted guidance expose unstable social judgments and alignment failures.

topics.name: Toxicity moderation under disagreement and drift
topics.summary: Multi-monitor moderation and disagreement-aware evaluation track shifting risk rather than treating aggregate labels as fixed truth. Adaptive selection and minority-sensitive analysis aim to reduce missed harmful content while representing uncertainty at contested boundaries.

topics.name: Robust speech recognition
topics.summary: Weak-label filtering, CTC-seeded editing, acoustic timing estimation, multilingual benchmarking, underwater recordings, and synthetic speech address noisy or mismatched supervision. Results emphasize external-domain accuracy, dialect and accent coverage, and efficient decoding.

topics.name: Cross-modal perception and speech semantics
topics.summary: Spectral sensitivity models, audio-language embeddings, and conversational speech benchmarks examine how perception and interpersonal stance are represented. The studies combine signal-level features with human-oriented evaluation to expose modality and prompt biases.

topics.name: Evidence-grounded multimodal retrieval
topics.summary: Dense retrieval, reranking, graph-based document context, adaptive budgets, and intent-aware recommendation connect evidence selection with downstream answers or next-item choices. Long documents and production video systems show the value of traceable intermediate reasoning.

topics.name: Mathematical and philosophical knowledge graphs
topics.summary: LLM voting filters noisy mathematical concept records, while temporally grounded graph analysis separates textual frequency from historical attribution across philosophical traditions. Both use graph structure to audit labels and discover relationships among concepts.

topics.name: Language models for structured data
topics.summary: LLM-generated pair supervision, latent bridges, and formal analyses of tabular foundation models address entity matching and multi-table questions. The common thread is injecting relational structure while controlling label noise and preserving scalable inference.

topics.name: Persistent memory for language agents
topics.summary: Versioned event memory, trusted assembly, and knowledge-topology designs manage what agents retain between interactions. Retrieval tests show that compact, typed context can outperform replaying complete histories when memory updates are gated and auditable.

topics.name: Agent security and execution integrity
topics.summary: Authorization boundaries, action alignment, latent-state integrity, runtime monitoring, memory attack tests, and MCP execution invariants protect tool-using agents. Healthcare, collaborative reasoning, and workflow evaluations show that visible messages alone are insufficient security evidence.

topics.name: Tool-agent evaluation and orchestration
topics.summary: Low-resource tool-use benchmarks, abstention policies, set-valued routing, metric-consistency audits, workflow studies, and scientific tool interfaces evaluate agents on cost, stopping, provenance, and execution reliability. Structured scoring exposes failures hidden by final-answer accuracy.

topics.name: LLM safety, backdoors, and narrative robustness
topics.summary: Multilingual tuning, runtime defeat devices, quantization backdoors, latent-class attacks, semantic signaling, narrative unlearning, and narrative-induced moral drift expose safety changes that ordinary accuracy misses. Multi-level behavioral tests motivate defenses based on internal structure, controlled adaptation, and robust audits.

topics.name: Fairness, bias, and algorithmic governance
topics.summary: Audit-grounded governance games, resume screening, recommender attacks, and academic access simulations measure how model or mechanism choices distribute opportunities. Counterfactual comparisons reveal demographic, regional, and status effects that require both auditing and adversarial stress tests.

topics.name: AI-ready data governance
topics.summary: Land registries, space-life-science repositories, and low-resource language corpora are examined through provenance, legal ownership, metadata, and license compatibility. Across settings, machine usability depends on durable validation and interoperable rights, not openness alone.

topics.name: Cybersecurity detection and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: Weak supervision, graph telemetry, diffusion-based signal recovery, poisoning defenses, and homomorphic validation address hostile or privacy-sensitive operational data. The recurring objective is to reduce analyst burden and preserve reliable decisions under adaptive attacks and noisy channels.

topics.name: Synthetic aperture radar data generation
topics.summary: Task-driven quality checks and cross-sensor diffusion with feature migration create radar data for label-scarce applications. The evaluations focus on whether synthetic samples preserve sensor-specific texture, speckle, and downstream task utility.

topics.name: Explainable machine learning and LLM evaluation
topics.summary: Tensor decomposition, thought-graph profiling, human nugget annotation, concept localization, and survey-simulator calibration make model behavior inspectable beyond final accuracy. Evaluations emphasize criterion-level evidence, reproducible labels, and fidelity to human judgments.

topics.name: Mathematical reasoning and formal systems
topics.summary: Theorem discovery, Lean proof repair, probabilistic accounts of in-context learning, formula challenges, and evolutionary search test whether models can transfer mathematical strategies. Verification and cross-task generalization guard against superficial answer quality.

topics.name: Scientific operator and dynamical modeling
topics.summary: Equivariant operator learning, graph surrogates, residual-certified Koopman dictionaries, and weak-balance identification learn physical dynamics from simulations or noisy measurements. Accuracy is paired with scaling, conditioning, spectral reliability, or interpretable mechanisms.

topics.name: Experimental mechanics and vocal-fold modeling
topics.summary: Projection registration aligns thermography with three-dimensional image correlation on curved surfaces, while a calibrated vocal-fold model matches video-derived glottal waveforms. Both fuse measurements with physics-based simulation to recover spatial or biomechanical state.

topics.name: Neuromorphic and graph computation
topics.summary: Spike-based graph search on SpiNNaker and a complex-valued event-driven neural model explore hardware-efficient temporal computation. Both use sparse parallel dynamics to reduce energy or represent magnitude-phase information.

topics.name: Causal and connectivity modeling in neuroimaging
topics.summary: Synthetic MRI generation with controlled causal structure provides ground truth for neuroimaging studies, while stochastic graph heat models estimate directed brain connectivity. Both use explicit structure to separate meaningful relations from spurious associations.

topics.name: Statistical guarantees and causal effects
topics.summary: Conformal procedures, design-based unbiased prediction, risk certification for structured generation, and doubly robust principal-stratum estimators formalize uncertainty under weak distributional assumptions. Simulations and a clinical trial show how coverage and heterogeneous effects can guide decisions.

topics.name: Gaussian-process uncertainty quantification
topics.summary: Quantum-aware kernel acquisition and Bayesian calibration use Gaussian processes when observations or simulations are costly. Applications in regression and aerodynamics show how targeted measurements can preserve predictive intervals while reducing evaluation expense.

topics.name: Sparse and high-dimensional biomedical prediction
topics.summary: Sparse principal components, varying-coefficient Bayesian trees, multi-omics breast-cancer prediction, and external diabetes validation address high-dimensional clinical data. Feature selection, multimodal inputs, calibration, and subgroup analysis determine whether apparent gains survive realistic deployment shifts.

topics.name: Tabular anomaly and feature learning
topics.summary: Density-based anomaly detection, kernel-Fisher ensembles, and evolutionary feature generation improve structured-data pipelines without relying solely on deep representations. Tests across heterogeneous datasets examine robustness, feature usefulness, and computational cost.

topics.name: Latent representation and set-learning theory
topics.summary: Latent-factor indeterminacy and learnability of set-valued structures examine when representations are identifiable, stable, and useful at scale. The theoretical perspectives connect classical factor models with modern generative and permutation-invariant learning.

topics.name: Predictive world models for embodied systems
topics.summary: Coupled latent dynamics, path-space prediction, multi-agent physics benchmarks, visual driving rollouts, and feature-space flow matching model future trajectories for planning. Synthetic pretraining and physical consistency improve long-horizon stability under distribution shift.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and tactile planning
topics.summary: Constraint-aware planning, tactile pose estimation, diffusion-policy recovery, keypose transfer, multi-contact roadmaps, and reachability filters address contact-rich manipulation. Experiments emphasize cross-embodiment transfer, robustness to perception errors, and provable or calibrated safety.

topics.name: Sim-to-real and UAV control
topics.summary: Physics calibration for table tennis, continuous-time UAV control, and LiDAR-camera localization address high-speed or GPS-denied deployment. Transfer improves through models of contacts, timing mismatch, and multimodal state uncertainty.

topics.name: Hierarchical robot navigation and autonomous planning
topics.summary: Semantic navigation, inverse-optimization policies, pedestrian trajectory certification, lunar resource mapping, and embodied driving assistants connect high-level goals to geometric or risk-aware control. Structured planning sits between perception and action across ground, aerial, and planetary settings.

topics.name: Autonomous driving safety and human interaction
topics.summary: Traffic scenario generation from driving data and analysis of human-interactive fallback behavior test autonomy under realistic road uncertainty. The shared focus is cooperation and failure handling when stopping or proceeding affects nearby people.

topics.name: Code-generation alignment and bug-fix evaluation
topics.summary: Preference tuning for code models is compared across pretrained and instruction-tuned bases, while a large diff-based benchmark exposes bug-fixing failures hidden by small repetitive tests. Functional correctness and maintainable software quality remain separate evaluation targets.

topics.name: Mechanistic analysis of language-model computation
topics.summary: Layer-wise feed-forward interventions and circuit analyses inspect how retrieval, language, formal reasoning, social reasoning, and physical reasoning are distributed internally. The findings point to signed, task-conditioned pathways and partially specialized neuron groups.
